t: Portal 111 — from the third to the fifth

b.x: Unblocking. Root, sacral, plexus, heart, throat, brow and crown. The astral chip placed in fear, in any of these seven, loses its name in this portal. Whoever enters lets go of the command that existed only while it was obeyed.

The page does not operate a body and does not pull an object out. The tone is 111 Hz, with the harmonics 222, 333 and 444 so a phone can carry the low note. The geometry is for looking. The phrase is the key a person accepts. What is not accepted does not leave. It does not dial. It does not replace a doctor.

Pineal. The block, in this portal, is the dark seal at the brow. The video opens the color: gold, violet, white and cyan. The sound is 963 Hz with the eagle's cry, and 111 underneath. The page does not clean a gland and does not remove a stone. Whoever looks lets go of the seal's name.
